description: Source code implementing I3C Common Command Code (CCC) functions for device communication, including get/set operations for device attributes and control commands.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getbcr
methods.description: Retrieve the Bus Characteristics Register (BCR) from a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getdcr
methods.description: Retrieve the Device Characteristics Register (DCR) from a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getpid
methods.description: Retrieve the PID (Product ID) from a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_rstact_all
methods.description: Send a reset action command to all devices via the controller.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_rstdaa_all
methods.description: Send a reset dynamic address assignment command to all devices.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setdasa
methods.description: Set the Dynamic Address of a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setnewda
methods.description: Assign a new dynamic address to a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_events_all_set
methods.description: Enable or disable events on all devices via the controller.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_events_set
methods.description: Enable or disable events on a specific target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setmwl_all
methods.description: Set the maximum write length for all devices via the controller.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setmwl
methods.description: Set the maximum write length for a specific device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getmwl
methods.description: Get the maximum write length from a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setmrl_all
methods.description: Set the maximum read length for all devices via the controller.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_setmrl
methods.description: Set the maximum read length for a specific device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getmrl
methods.description: Get the maximum read length from a target device.

methods.name: i3c_ccc_do_getstatus
methods.description: Retrieve status information from a target device in specified format.
